scope: Adoption policy derived from ALLOCATION_SITES.json via tools/classify_allocation_sites.py. Records decisions and evidence only; switches no runtime path and qualifies no performance. Sites without an entry default to System/dense.

entries.rationale: P1-07 five-slot reuse already exists; not counted as a Memory increment.
P2-05 holder packing and idle reuse already exist.
Stack/std::array geometry; no proven heap allocation point.
Engine/ncnn/GPU owners keep staging and retirement.
Containers must outlive submit_and_wait; an arena chunk would stay pinned. Compare plain reserve first.
Endpoints are Rust/Java arrays, not leases; migration cost unknown until shadow data exists.
Single dense long-lived input; arena saves no provider call (recorded A1/A3 backing ratio 1.0).
Stable preloaded owner can be borrowed via the external-import contract instead of copied.
Buffer sizes follow image dimensions; distribution must be shadow-estimated per workload.
Both endpoints are existing leases; direct transfer removes the Java staging array.
